answer: Perfect! All 126 tests now pass. The issue was in the `bulk_discount` function in `shopcart/pricing.py` at line 14. The condition `if qty > BULK_THRESHOLD:` was too strict—it only applied the discount when quantity exceeded the threshold, but the docstring and tests indicated the discount should apply when quantity equals the threshold or more. Changed it to `if qty >= BULK_THRESHOLD:` to fix it.
